900.5.10(40).explanation: Exception RT 40 has no site specific provisions. The lands are subject to City of Toronto by-law 1096-2006 as a prevailing by-law, which we do not evaluate.

900.5.10(127).explanation: Exception RT 127 sets the minimum lot frontage and lot area at what existed on the enactment date of By-law 569-2013, one dwelling unit per lot, a 6.0 m front setback where the rear lot line also abuts a street and 5.1 m otherwise, 50 percent maximum lot coverage, a 1.5 m side setback, and the required parking space inside the residential building.

900.5.10(278).explanation: Exception RT 278 sets the minimum lot frontage and lot area at what existed on the enactment date of By-law 569-2013, street setbacks of 7.5 m or 6.0 m depending on the named street, side setbacks of 1.2 m (4.5 m on a street side), a 0.3 m garage side setback, 50 percent maximum lot coverage, the required parking space inside the residential building, and compliance with exception 900.5.10(352).
